reason: The kidney vessels connect the existing body to the organs whose filtration the goal asks me to trace.

reason: The tubule and its surrounding vessels appear suited to moving useful substances back into the blood.

effect: Glucose is recovered into the blood, while some water and urea remain in the tubule. The water channels look like the next part of recovery.
reaction: The arrows make the glucose recovery easy to follow.
reason: Water channels in the tubule wall could let some of the remaining water return to the blood.

choice.with: Water channels in the tubule wall

expectation: Some water will move from the tubule toward the surrounding blood vessel.

effect: Water has returned to the blood, and the remaining fluid continues toward becoming urine. The new goal is to connect its route to the bladder.
reaction: The remaining water and urea make the transition from recovery to urine formation clear.
reason: The collecting passages lead from the kidney tubules toward the kidney's outlet.
expectation: The remaining fluid will pass into the collecting passages toward the kidney's outlet.

reaction: The route is straightforward to follow.
reason: The ureters connect the kidney outlets to the bladder, completing the requested route.
expectation: Urine will travel from the kidneys through the ureters to the bladder.

effect: The ureters and bladder completed the route from both kidneys to urine storage, and the chapter's goals are complete.
reaction: The final picture makes the route easy to follow.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood was the most worthwhile step: showing glucose entering the filtered fluid alongside urea made the need to recover useful substances clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting passages and then the ureters was clear, but the choices felt predictable once the route was established.

surprise.text: I was struck that useful glucose is filtered out along with waste before being recovered into the blood.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each part had an evident role in the route, although the sequence offered few uncertain choices.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the body systems connect, though I would hope for more decisions that require weighing possibilities.
